detailed_description: GLM-Image is a image-generation model with strong text rendering and supports image-to-image tasks (editing, style transfer, identity-preserving generation, multi-subject consistency).

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Positive text prompt. (Tip from official docs: wrap text that must appear in the image in quotation marks.)

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description: Optional conditioning image URL for image-to-image (edit / style transfer / etc). Supported formats: .jpg / .jpeg / .png. Max 10MB.

parameters.name: guidance_scale
parameters.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Official examples use 1.5.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output image height in pixels. Must be divisible by 32 (per official docs).

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output image width in pixels. Must be divisible by 32 (per official docs).

parameters.name: num_inference_steps
parameters.description: Number of denoising steps. Official examples use 50.
